analysis.rationale: 2-step deterministic pipeline: motion blur (sev3) -> JPEG (sev3). JPEG existence is high-confidence from block_boundary=2.1051 (0%FP) and dct_zero_ratio=0.8915; joint PSNR optimum at jpeg:3 (31.27 vs 21.48/25.11 for 2/4). Blur type motion from FFT anisotropy=3.61/gm_ratio=0.4225, confirmed by PSNR ablation (+6.8 dB over gaussian/glass at same severity) and hf_lf ratio match (0-2%). Noise ruled out (noise_prior sigma=0.99<2; gamma/YCrCb risk attributed to JPEG-blocking residual pollution). Global ruled out (mean_shift=0, variance_ratio=0.951, saturation_chroma_ratio=0.972). Verdict kept at UNCERTAIN because joint PSNR=31.27 falls in 30-40 band (SKILL: 30-40 -> UNCERTAIN), though severity scans on both steps show a single sharp optimum. Cross-validation on 4 held-out pairs: PSNR 22.40/22.62/24.25/27.07 dB (mean 24.1), CI 8-9/10, unique_R/G/B within 0-2%, hf_lf <=2%, block_boundary diff 5-12% consistent -> same degradation transfers across the support set (PSNR spread attributed to content-dependent motion-kernel/JPEG interaction).
